name: pr-review-loop
description: Takes open GitHub PRs to approved and mergeable: asks the reviewer once, fixes or answers each finding, reruns your checks, merges only when you ask.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: GitHub login whose approval counts. Leave empty to be asked each run.

ask_via.title: How to ask the reviewer
ask_via.description: github-review requests a review on each PR. comment posts one PR comment that mentions the reviewer.

gate_command.title: Gate command
gate_command.description: Checks that must pass before a PR is READY. <n> is the PR number.

e2e_command.title: End-to-end command
e2e_command.description: Optional extra suite, run in the PR's worktree when the diff changes behavior. Empty skips it.

max_rounds.title: Max review rounds
max_rounds.description: Review rounds per PR before it stops and hands the PR back to you.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the watcher checks GitHub for reviewer activity.

bump_after_minutes.title: Bump after (minutes)
bump_after_minutes.description: Silence after the ask before one reminder. After that the stall is reported to you.

worktree_pattern.title: Worktree folder
worktree_pattern.description: Folder name for each PR's worktree, created next to your checkout. <repo> is the checkout's folder name, <n> the PR number.

merge_method.title: Merge method
merge_method.description: squash, merge or rebase. Used only on runs started with --merge.
